title: Read explicitly selected engineering records
description: Retrieve recorded values from a coherent supported registered change snapshot according to exact actor selection. Preserve each query's content, scope, absence, and continuation contract without evaluating readiness or changing records.
inputs: Selected supported change identity and explicit status/context/show/advanced-inspection request.
Selection filters, requested complete or allowed projection detail, output budget, and any expected revision/cursor.
outputs: Selected records, complete explanations or requested projections with actual record contract, revision, identities, applicability where specified, and exact scope.
Known counts, omissions, optional absence, missing paths, continuation, or explicit structural/I/O/conflict/recovery outcomes.
behavior: Resolve authority from the declared registry and obtain a coherent snapshot or an explicit busy/recovery-required outcome.
Apply literal filters with declared combination, deduplication and ordering; never infer relevance, add stage-selected records, or derive a next action.

Return complete selected Verify and shared material-decision explanation without unrelated bodies; preserve Review/findings differences and explicitly requested field selection with omission/absence metadata.
Distinguish no entry, unregistered optional record, registered missing content, unknown selected total, unreadability and malformation; do not infer a contract for an absent or invalid store.
Bind pagination to normalized selection and observed revision, return only whole admissible items, and reject oversized first items or changed/invalid continuation without partial content.
Supply raw selected values and exact scope to result projection; no renderer/projection becomes a second authoritative record or modifies stored bytes.
A missing operational store is reported as unavailable history, distinct from an available store with no matching records; reads never initialize, import or restore a store implicitly.

failure_behavior.condition: The expected revision/cursor no longer identifies the requested coherent selection.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report conflict or invalid continuation without selected items; require a fresh actor choice.

failure_behavior.condition: Selected data is unavailable, unsafe, malformed, unsupported, or exceeds the declared complete-output bounds.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return the specific missing/incomplete/rejected outcome without substituting empty success, truncating content, or performing recovery.
